description: Save the candidate's job search, the one their board, recommend_jobs and their job alerts read: the roles they want (the first is the main one), their seniority, the places (as people say them: "Bay Area or Seattle", "Canada", "remote"), whether they want remote, hybrid or on-site work, and optionally a yearly salary range. Save what the candidate told you or said yes to (import_resume's suggested_search is a start), and say in one line what you saved: no need to ask first. A field you leave out is untouched; one you send replaces what was saved. A place that cannot be read is refused with suggestions, never widened. With no profile yet, this starts one.

places.description: Where they want to work, as people say it: "Bay Area", "NYC or Seattle", "Canada", "remote".

roles.description: e.g. ["Backend Engineer", "Machine Learning Engineer"]; the first is the main role.

seniority.description: The rungs they want, e.g. ["new-grad"] or ["senior", "staff-plus"]; "intern" adds internships.

name: update_job_search
title: Save my job search
